description: The native Rust extern-crate identity remains the original crate name across alias changes and merges independently from a function edit.

input.base:
extern crate alloc as memory;
fn stable() -> i32 { 1 }
input.ours:
extern crate alloc as arena;
fn stable() -> i32 { 1 }
input.theirs:
extern crate alloc as memory;
fn stable() -> i32 { 2 }

expected.output:
extern crate alloc as arena;
fn stable() -> i32 { 2 }
